_about: Full-episode-only keys for E15 (Shadow IT) that the wiring agent pastes into the FULL erb only (scenarios/awareness_e15_shadow_it/scenario.json.erb). The defend-only shell (e15_shadow_it_defend) carries NONE of these: its stages are brief, defend, debrief, with no mistake and no flip. Each key below has a _notes line saying exactly where it goes. E15 carries only three full-only keys (mistake, flip, and the erb-only string flipMontageByChoice). NOTE on sortDrill: unlike the generic AGENT_RULES_CONTENT list, E15's sortDrill (Swap Shop) is NOT full-only: E15 section 13 keeps it in the defend-only shell too, so it lives in defend.json's awarenessEpisode and is NOT repeated here. There is no guess, assistant, privacyPanel, concernForm, flipAftermath, stepLabels or playerSentAuth for E15.

mistake._notes: Goes into the FULL erb only, at social.awarenessEpisode.mistake (sibling of defend/strings). Identical to mistake.json's mistake block. Absent from the defend-only shell. ENG-04 lint: exactly one safe:true option per beat; flipBeat names a real beat. Safe-option position varies across beats (not always first).

beats.situation: The share has crawled to a halt and the pack is due Monday. Colin: "Just email the pack to your personal address and finish it off at home." The compose window offers "Me (personal)" in the autocomplete.

options.label: Ask Nilesh about remote access and work from home that way
Send the pack to your personal email to finish at home

beats.situation: Colin: "Add the client's night contact to the drivers' group chat on our own phones. It's how we pass round addresses and photos of signed notes anyway."

options.label: Add the client's contact to the drivers' personal group chat
Ask IT for an approved team channel, and share the address there

beats.situation: A visiting surveyor holds out their own USB stick with the site drawings on it: "Just pop it in your laptop, it's quicker than emailing."

options.label: Plug the visitor's stick into your laptop
Ask them to send the drawings through the firm's file-sharing link instead

beats.situation: Shauna rings: the delivery rota lives in a free app on a former temp's personal account, and anyone with the link can edit it. She wants this week's slots added.

options.label: Hold off, and ask IT to move the rota into the team space
Add this week's slots to the free app, and sort the rest later

flip._notes: Goes into the FULL erb only, at social.awarenessEpisode.flip. Absent from the defend-only shell.

strings._notes: flipMontageByChoice goes into the FULL erb only, at social.awarenessEpisode.strings.flipMontageByChoice. It is ERB-ONLY and must be added to STRINGS_ERB_ONLY_OK in test/js/social-awareness-fragment-erb-parity.test.mjs (ENG-04 adds it there, like flipDefenderLineByChoice). flipHeading ('Six months later') is NOT here: it lives in defend.json's strings and is shared by both shells. Keyed beat then option; every outer key is a real beat and every inner key a real option of that beat (ENG-04 lint). personal_email is shown first (it is the flipBeat); the montage still shows every beat. Text is verbatim from E15 section 10. The 'Your choice' / 'the version where it was taken instead' framing is in the text, not applied by the engine, so a line is authored for BOTH options of every beat (the unsafe-option fallback never fires for E15).

personal_email.send_personal: Months on, the personal inbox was broken into with a reused password; the pack sat in its sent items, and the client got a convincing fake invoice built from it.
personal_email.ask_nilesh: Through remote access the pack never left the firm, so there was nothing outside to find. The version where it went to a personal inbox instead was broken into with a reused password and copied.

drivers_chat.add_to_group: The chat grew to forty people, two of them long gone from the firm. A photo of a delivery note with a customer's home address was passed on outside it.
drivers_chat.ask_channel: IT set up a team channel within a day, and anyone who left lost access with their account. The version where the personal group chat stayed in use had a delivery note photo passed on outside the firm.

visitor_stick.plug_visitor: The surveyor's stick had been in three other firms' laptops first. It copied the folders it could reach, and Tarrowby had to tell two clients.
visitor_stick.send_link: The drawings came through the firm's link and were checked on the way in, so nothing arrived on a stick. The version where the stick went into the laptop carried a program that copied the folders it could reach.

rota_app.use_app: The rota stayed editable by the departed temp, then vanished when the free app closed the unused account, the week before a busy run.
rota_app.ask_it: IT moved the rota to the team space in minutes. The version where it stayed in the free app could still be edited by the departed temp, and was lost when the account was closed.
